collection.title: MODIS/Aqua Aerosol Cloud Water Vapor Ozone Monthly L3 Global 1Deg CMG

access: Earthdata Login (environment token); LAADS OPeNDAP DAP4 server-side subset of one variable per month, in memory (no raw file kept)
regrid: none: product is already 1 degree (180 x 360); HDF4 stored ints decoded once as scale*(stored-offset), fill and out-of-range -> NaN
note: Raw granules are not kept; only the 1-degree monthly derivative is shipped. No trend statistic is computed in the build.
